The frozen template solve.sh likewise uses a static copy.

Within the frozen task, environment/assets/seed_data.json:3 is snippets: []; solution/app/server.js:112-130 only opens/creates the schema, with no boot inserts or network reads. Built-in choices are the fixed array in src/app.tsx:7 and are loaded from committed local /starters files at :53-59, served by server.js:100; public/index.html:1-2 uses committed local JS/CSS. hello.js:3-8 has fixed 1-through-12 squared output. Saved IDs are SQLite AUTOINCREMENT (server.js:119); revisions start at 1 and increment on accepted updates (:72,84). The workbook explicitly limits this row to pinned values, so those incidental values are not treated as defects. No required row-20 evidence remains missing.
